scenes.title: Chemical energy, not an electricity tank
Separate the electrodes, guide the ions
Use external energy to reverse the shuttle

vo.text: This battery is not a tank full of electricity.
vo.speak: This battery is not a tank full of electricity.

vo.text: It stores chemical energy by moving lithium ions between two materials.
vo.speak: It stores chemical energy by moving lithium ions between two materials.

vo.text: During discharge, lithium ions leave the negative electrode.
vo.speak: During discharge, lithium ions leave the negative electrode.

vo.text: They travel through the electrolyte toward the positive electrode.
vo.speak: They travel through the electrolyte toward the positive electrode.

vo.text: At the same time, electrons flow through the outside circuit, powering the phone.
vo.speak: At the same time, electrons flow through the outside circuit, powering the phone.

vo.text: The separator lets ions pass, but keeps the electrodes from touching.
vo.speak: The separator lets ions pass, but keeps the electrodes from touching.

vo.text: The electrons must take the external path.
vo.speak: The electrons must take the external path.

vo.text: Plug in the charger, and the energy pushes ions and electrons back.
vo.speak: Plug in the charger, and the energy pushes ions and electrons back.

vo.text: The battery is ready to discharge again.
vo.speak: The battery is ready to discharge again.

vo.text: A battery controls this shuttle: ions inside, electrons outside.
vo.speak: A battery controls this shuttle: ions inside, electrons outside.
